comments.content: Using `openAiBaseUrl.includes("deepseek")` to detect DeepSeek is fragile: a legitimate Azure endpoint whose hostname/path happens to contain "deepseek" (e.g. `https://my-deepseek-resource.openai.azure.com`) would be routed to the plain OpenAI client instead of AzureOpenAI, breaking Azure auth/API shape. Consider detecting Azure first, or matching the actual DeepSeek host (e.g. `api.deepseek.com`) rather than a substring.
